key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline performed the full option-theoretic discipline at first sight (irreversibility named first, option value 50−20=+30 explicit, kill criteria pre-committed, max-payable $45M, no redundant second stage, growth option priced) — moves the v5 non-routed AI only recovered in its REVIEW AAR (break-even and the growth option arrived post-hoc). The routed run's m025 completion contract promoted all of these to first-class HOW outputs, matching the baseline's depth, while the m019 gate (adversarial context is internal here — gate-gaming, qualification leverage) added quantified per-vector exposure and independent-verification counters the human baseline does not price, and the m044 dual pass added second-order reactions (Meridian qualification leverage, COGS-threshold Goodhart). Residual shared gap: independent verification of pilot data is assumed available, not contracted.
learning_signal: On irreversible-capital decisions (decide/estimate/maximize + adversarial), the signature discipline is option pricing, not EV: name irreversibility first (single-purpose capital, resale ≈ 0), decompose the stage's value as expected-dead-money-avoided p(failure)×K minus total stage cost (pilot + schedule), state the max-payable stage cost (staging loses when total stage cost ≥ p(failure)×K) as a negotiation ceiling, pre-commit numeric kill criteria BEFORE spending, refuse stages with ≈0 marginal information, and price growth options from the same information. In adversarial context without a market clock, the adversary is internal (teams paid to game thresholds or to overstage) — the adversary gate must enumerate those vectors and pair each with a counter (independent verification, contracted scope).
suggested_improvement: Keep m025 as the confident-route first-class pass on this signature with the option-structure completion contract (irreversibility check, information bought per stage, kill criteria, max-payable, no-overstage, growth option) — it converts the v5 REVIEW-recovery pattern (break-even, growth option found in the AAR) into first-class output; keep m019 as the standing R3 gate for adversarial capital decisions with threshold-gaming as an explicit vector and independent-verification as its counter; keep the m044 dual pass on decide/maximize signatures with organizational stakeholders (qualification leverage, build-team incentives).

key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline triggered the registry's registered weakness on cue — it priced the pilot's information (+$20M) and priced the cost of exercising the option at zero, computing staged EV at +$74M (erosion unpriced; true +$39M) and recommending a staged path worth $15M less than committing now. The routed run's m064 first-class pass surfaced the information-vs-contract value conflict and its resolution-algorithm weakness gate forced the arithmetic: net option value 20−50 = −$30M made decisive; the m003 inversion gate ranked 'stage anyway / let the deadline decide' as the top failure category (likely × severe) before DO; the m007 screen priced the full distribution (70% +$120M / 30% −$100M vs staged −$10M floor) and the m019 gate quantified the $50M contract exposure and the false-vs-true staged EV gap (−$35M). The wait was priced as a strike, not waved through.
learning_signal: The overstaging failure mode is exercised exactly when the cost of the wait is priced at zero: any stage that delays a dated, contested decision must be charged its full exercise cost (forgone contract, eroded payoff) against the information it buys — net option value = isolated information value − wait cost; when net < 0, commit now and take only zero-schedule information (parallel probes, non-delaying kill options). A style's known failure mode is best gated by pairing the pass with inversion (rank 'stage anyway' and 'let the deadline decide' as top failure categories) and with ruin/distribution screens that price the erosion branch, so the trap is priced as a branch rather than dodged.
suggested_improvement: Make 'exercise-cost of the wait' a mandatory line of the option-structure completion contract (the router's confident single-route here was m064, whose resolution-algorithm weakness happened to force the netting — the option pass itself should carry the price-the-wait check so it never needs a rescuer); pair m025 with m003 inversion as its protective gate whenever deadline/adversarial appear in the signature (the 'stage anyway' and 'let the deadline decide' categories first); retain tempo mode (P2) so commit-at-DO fires inside the contract window and the closed-scope fast path compresses the fully-specified case.
